calculations.name: FY2024-FY2026总普通股桥
calculations.formula: ending_total = beginning_A + beginning_B + option_exercises + conversion_A_to_B_net_zero + repurchases + employee_net_issuance + other_share_changes
calculations.boundary: Class A-to-B conversion is zero in combined shares; these totals are point-in-time outstanding shares, not weighted-average diluted EPS shares.

calculations.name: 12-month主要高管官方事件计数
calculations.formula: count distinct completed role exit/separation events and appointments with effective dates inside [2025-09-19, 2026-09-19]
calculations.boundary: Event count is not a rule-defined concentration measure and cannot itself establish a stability or organization score.
